because: The loose negatives have no envelope, so no job and no log row: they wait to be identified.
A job's envelope is the unit the paper filed: each envelope folder, under its year, is one item with all its rolls.
The shot log has a row per job and describes the envelopes.
The paper's archive is browsed by year, and each year folder is a set.
note: The transposed job number in the log is paired by hand and its identifier corrected as decisions in the frozen plan, not as edits: no edit kind names one row.
